def build(context,records,low):
    """Build every snapshot and the frozen request activity table."""
    leases=context['leases']
    kinds=context['services']
    lease_order=context['lease_order']
    service_order=context['service_order']
    requests=context['requests']
    by_query={}
    for request_id,row in requests.items():
        by_query.setdefault(row['at'],[]).append(request_id)
    ledger=Ledger(records)
    snapshots=[]
    active={request_id:False for request_id in requests}
    for moment in context['queries']:
        live,counts=ledger.at(moment)
        roles=classify(live,leases,moment)
        clean={}
        entries=[]
        for lease_id in lease_order:
            info=leases[lease_id]
            if not (info['start']<=moment<info['end']):
                entries.append(lease_snapshot(lease_id,'inactive',[],[],[],[],[]))
                continue
            state=roles.get(lease_id,EMPTY)
            internal=state['I']
            external=state['E']
            conflicts=internal&external
            if state['alias']:
                name='alias'
            elif conflicts:
                name='conflict'
            else:
                name='usable'
            planned=low[lease_id]
            if name=='usable':
                entry=lease_snapshot(lease_id,name,addr(conflicts),addr(internal),
                                     addr(external),addr(planned-internal-external),[])
                clean[lease_id]=(internal,external,state['witI'],state['witE'])
            else:
                entry=lease_snapshot(lease_id,name,addr(conflicts),[],[],addr(planned),[])
            entries.append(entry)
        tables={}
        unbound=0
        groups={}
        for row in live:
            if row[0]!=APP:
                continue
            lease_id=row[5]
            usable=clean.get(lease_id)
            if usable is None:
                unbound+=1
                continue
            target=row[7]
            internal,external,wit_i,wit_e=usable
            if target in internal:
                witness=wit_i.get(target); role=0
            elif target in external:
                witness=wit_e.get(target); role=1
            else:
                unbound+=1
                continue
            if witness is None or witness>row[6]:
                unbound+=1
                continue
            key=(lease_id,target,row[11],role)
            bucket=groups.get(key)
            if bucket is None:
                groups[key]=[row]
            else:
                bucket.append(row)
        for (lease_id,target,service,role),rows in groups.items():
            peak=max(row[12] for row in rows)
            latest=[row for row in rows if row[12]==peak]
            name,errors=status_of(latest,kinds[service])
            if name=='unknown' and not errors:
                continue
            table=tables.setdefault(lease_id,{})
            bucket=table.get(service)
            if bucket is None:
                bucket=table[service]={'io':set(),'ic':set(),'eo':set(),'ec':set(),
                                       'err':0}
            if name=='open':
                (bucket['io'] if role==0 else bucket['eo']).add(target)
            elif name=='closed':
                (bucket['ic'] if role==0 else bucket['ec']).add(target)
            bucket['err']+=errors
        for index,entry in enumerate(entries):
            lease_id=entry['lease']
            usable=clean.get(lease_id)
            table=tables.get(lease_id,{})
            services=[]
            for service in service_order:
                bucket=table.get(service)
                if bucket is None:
                    services.append({'id':service,'internal_open':[],
                                     'internal_closed':[],'external_open':[],
                                     'external_closed':[],'internal_only':[],
                                     'protocol_errors':0})
                    continue
                internal_open=addr(bucket['io'])
                external_open=addr(bucket['eo'])
                external_closed=addr(bucket['ec'])
                if usable and usable[1] and all(member in bucket['ec']
                                                for member in usable[1]):
                    internal_only=list(internal_open)
                else:
                    internal_only=[]
                services.append({'id':service,'internal_open':internal_open,
                                 'internal_closed':addr(bucket['ic']),
                                 'external_open':external_open,
                                 'external_closed':external_closed,
                                 'internal_only':internal_only,
                                 'protocol_errors':bucket['err']})
            entry['services']=services
        for request_id in by_query.get(moment,()):
            row=requests[request_id]
            usable=clean.get(row['lease'])
            ready=False
            if usable is not None:
                target=row['address']
                if target in usable[0]:
                    bucket=tables.get(row['lease'],{}).get(row['service'])
                    if bucket is None or (target not in bucket['io']
                                          and target not in bucket['ic']):
                        ready=True
            active[request_id]=ready
        snapshots.append({'at':moment,'ledger':counts,
                          'unbound_applications':unbound,'leases':entries})
